approved_payload.content: A water pipe burst along the original pipeline near the Adshade Street bridge over the R71 in Tzaneen, leaving residents with water supply problems (Letaba Herald, 19 October). Greater Tzaneen Municipality DA councillor Chrisma Bredenkamp said the damaged asbestos pipe is being replaced with steel; the replacement pipe has to come from Cape Town. Workers could not reach the section through the tunnel under the bridge and had to open the area above the pipeline. When the pipe burst is not stated, so the date is the report date. The arrival date of the pipe and the completion date were not confirmed; the municipality's spokesperson had not replied by publication. One report. The pin is approximate (street level).
